purpose: Recover actual calibrated DESI DR1 host spectra for the existing observed OzDES/Dovekie host cohort; no inference of true progenitor age from a spectral index.
coordinate_source: OzDES host RA/DEC, not SN transient position
comparison_coordinate: DESI zpix mean_fiber_ra/mean_fiber_dec; verify native target coordinates after retrieval
ambiguous_rule: Retain all spatial candidates; a clean association requires one distinct target within radius. Multiple survey/program spectra of one target are not independent galaxies. Select the released primary spectrum only after identity screening.

Dn4000.definition: Ratio of mean signed Fnu in red and blue rest-wavelength intervals; weights include partial pixel overlaps, no positivity or SNR censoring of flux. Report delta-method ratio error only when denominator exceeds five nominal standard deviations. Raw signed band flux and variance always retained.

Hdelta_A.definition: Rest-frame equivalent width against a linear continuum through sideband means, absorption positive; propagate independent native-pixel variance with numerical/analytic gradient. This is a native-resolution diagnostic, not a Lick-resolution index or stellar age.

mask_rule: Reject pixels with any nonzero native mask or nonpositive/nonfinite inverse variance; do not reject negative flux.
uncertainty_scope: Released diagonal inverse variance is conditional statistical information, not full calibrated spectral covariance. Known DR1 flux-calibration IVAR bug becomes significant at per-pixel SNR20-30; do not silently repair or treat errors as complete. Store signed per-pixel SNR, threshold fractions and sensitivities; no arbitrary factor-five correction.
calibration_scope: DESI flux calibration improves on OzDES counts, but aperture, response, dust, emission infill, resolution and stellar-population assumptions remain. No absolute luminosity or cosmology fit from indices.

spectral_operator_declared_before_extrac.join_rule: Fixed midpoints in camera overlaps; one native camera per wavelength without resampling or SNR-based arm selection. All original arms remain available for forward modelling.
spectral_operator_declared_before_extrac.foreground_extinction: Indices use released observed flux without Milky Way correction; native EBV retained for future physical modelling.
spectral_operator_declared_before_extrac.Hdelta_wavelength_convention: Declared edges applied on vacuum rest-wavelength grid. Native-resolution window diagnostic, not exact air-wavelength Lick index.
spectral_operator_declared_before_extrac.missing_feature_pixels: Equivalent width integrates only the available feature width; coverage reported, no imputed feature flux.
spectral_operator_declared_before_extrac.covariance: Propagate native diagonal inverse variance through all shared bands and derived-index gradients; resolution is a response operator, not extra noise covariance.

download_scope: Public matched spectra only, using SPARCL or targeted NERSC HEALPix byte-range reads. Do not acquire a complete catalogue or production spectra tree.
